title: I Need Thee Every Hour
author: Annie Sherwood Hawks (1836-1918)
firstLine: I need Thee ev'ry hour, Most gracious Lord;
verses: I need Thee ev'ry hour, Most gracious Lord;
No tender voice like Thine Can peace afford.
I need Thee ev'ry hour, Stay Thou near by;
Temptations lose their pow'r When Thou art nigh.
I need Thee ev'ry hour, In joy or pain;
Come quickly and abide, Or life is vain.
I need Thee ev'ry hour, Teach me Thy will;
And Thy rich promises In me fulfill.
I need Thee ev'ry hour, Most Holy One;
O make me Thine indeed, Thou blessed Son!
refrain: I need Thee, O I need Thee;
O bless me now, my Savior, I come to Thee!
